name: imessage-mcp
description: Read, search and send iMessage, including photos and PDFs, on macOS without Full Disk Access. Requires the iMessage MCP app.

interface.shortDescription: Read, search and send iMessage, with photos and PDFs
interface.longDescription: Gives Codex and ChatGPT agents access to your Messages through the iMessage MCP macOS app: chats, search, photos and PDFs, and sending with on-screen confirmation. The app runs in the macOS sandbox, needs no Full Disk Access, and asks you to approve every connection and every message sent.
defaultPrompt: Show the latest messages in my chat named ADA and tell me what is needed from me.
Read the attachments in that chat and summarize them.
Search my messages for 'invoice' from the last month.
